services.desc: Encountering wildlife can be a once-in-a lifetime opportunity! For their safety as well as yours, please follow the guidelines below, give wildlife plenty of space, be aware of local regulations and use your zoom lens or binoculars if you want that close-up view! Continue reading and take the pledge to have a memorable experience. Attempting to touch, handle, or ride wildlife can injure the animal, put you at risk and is illegal for many species. Some animals come to shore to rest and feed- there may be nothing wrong. Do not approach any wildlife, even if it appears sick or orphaned. Instead, contact the local authorities for help.
